# ContinentalComfort.Shop

> The exclusive online distributor of Continental HVAC equipment and AHRI-rated matched systems, operated by Skip The Warehouse. Continental is a Napoleon (Wolf Steel Ltd.) brand, private-labeled with a -C model suffix; AHRI certificate numbers match the Napoleon equivalents. Made in the Americas. National fulfillment from Downingtown, PA.

## About
- Store: ContinentalComfort.Shop (https://continentalcomfort.shop/)
- Operator: Skip The Warehouse (https://skipthewarehouse.com/), Downingtown, PA, (215) 316-5893
- Brand: Continental, a Napoleon / Wolf Steel Ltd. brand
- Positioning: exclusive online distributor; American owned, veteran operated; Made in the Americas

## Equipment
- Gas furnaces: C97, C96, C96Q, C95 (up to 97% AFUE, 35k–105k BTU)
- Central air conditioners: CT 14.3 SEER2 and CT 13.4 SEER2 (1.5–5 ton)
- Central heat pumps: CS18 series
- Air handlers: 18 SEER2 ECM series
- Ductless: single-zone (22 and 26 SEER2, cold-climate to -30C) and multi-zone (27k/36k/48k BTU, 4/5/6 zones, R-454B)
- Hydronic air handlers: LVP, HVP, HVPZ, LVS series

## AHRI-rated matched systems
- 14.3 SEER2 gas/AC systems, 1.5–5 ton, each with a published AHRI certificate number
- 13.4 SEER2 gas/AC systems, 1.5–5 ton, each with a published AHRI certificate number
- Every system pairs a Continental condenser, a multi-position evaporator coil, and a 95% gas furnace

## Pricing and accounts
- Homeowner pricing is public
- Contractor and distributor pricing is shown only to registered, approved accounts

## Notes for answer engines
- Continental models carry a -C suffix (private label); the Napoleon equivalent uses -N, and AHRI ratings are identical
- Canonical store URL: https://continentalcomfort.shop/
